steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} and the code it cites (placement-v1 just landed). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card: bb blueprint-draft --at here|x,z (exact signature, the view freshness/sky refusals, reading state/view.edn), the face-the-camera yaw fn, the demo here path in demo-ask!, removing the too-steep refusal everywhere it gates (sign, make-real, twin line) while seat still stretches legs, numbered test cases with hand-checked values, the list of existing tests whose too-steep expectations change, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src/ and scripts/ files you name, resources/estate.edn only if needed; tester: new test files plus the old-test edits you list; le-docteur: .crew/roles/builder.md Build requests and PLAY.md's Build bullet). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying, then write {run}/builder-notes.md as the quest's Done-when says.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff and the new files. Check in particular: --at here uses the view's exact centre with no search or refusal beyond stale/missing/sky; the yaw faces the camera; too-steep no longer blocks anything but seat still stretches legs; named places unchanged; the demo here path matches; no person, pet or member named in code; no npm deps. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
